rationale: The workflow already implements several evidence-supported optimizations: concurrency-based stale run cancellation (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE), a dedicated lint job that runs once instead of per matrix entry, bundler caching via ruby/setup-ruby, and comprehensive step-level timeouts (15 min for specs, 10 min for gem test, 5 min for locale install and workflow lint). The P-LIT-FAIL-FAST pattern is contraindicated because the build-complete job requires all matrix outcomes to report a stable required-check status (the workflow comment explicitly explains why fail-fast: false is necessary). P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT's job-level timeout would be largely redundant given existing step-level timeouts on all long-running steps; the one job without a timeout (links) is low-risk and fast in practice. Other patterns (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE, P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER, P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW) either already apply or have negligible reported impact. No evidence-supported optimization with met preconditions and no contraindications remains to apply.
